name: Calma
author: Joan Reyero
description: A distraction blocker that is hard to argue with. Daily session budgets for X, YouTube and anything else; blocked system-wide outside sessions, minimal versions inside; loosening needs a password you can give away. The bar widget shows the countdown and starts or ends sessions.

barWidget.description: Countdown of the open session; click for every rule, its sessions and minutes left, and Start / End buttons.

schema.label: Hide the widget when no session is open
Daemon port
schema.description: The port calmad listens on at 127.0.0.1. Leave at 7390 unless CALMA_PORT is set.
